name: readme-commands
body:
README command reference: README.md documents every user-facing command — `init` (with its optional `[path]` argument and `--local` flag), `init-library`, `config`, `start`, `templates`, `templates <name>`, `upgrade`, `version`, and `help` — each with its usage, and its table of contents resolves to every section (no stale or missing entries).

AC: README.md documents `init`, `init-library`, `config`, `start`, `templates`, `templates <name>`, `upgrade`, `version` and `help`; `upgrade` is documented with its no-path-argument, no-`--force` behaviour; every table-of-contents entry links to a heading that exists, and every command section is reachable from the table of contents.
